queue.construct: const sample = std.math.cast(i16, s) orelse { f.failed = true; return 1; };
queue.reason: This is test code checking for a decoded value outside i16 range. Before decoding, streamInfo asserts bits == 16, and libFLAC never hands a 16-bit stream's write callback values outside i16, so the orelse branch exists only 'in case'. `@intCast` would state the same invariant, and a violation would still fail the test (as a safety panic).
queue.riskIfWrong: If a corrupt FLAC ever produced out-of-range samples, the test would panic on @intCast instead of failing cleanly through expect(!f.failed). It is still a test failure, only less readable.
